selected_evidence.requirement: Run the required worker as inventory-worker with automatic recovery configured
selected_evidence.summary: The validated unit uses the exact required executable, User/Group inventory-worker, and Restart=on-failure; direct process evidence shows it active under that account.

selected_evidence.requirement: Service recovers automatically after the worker fails
selected_evidence.summary: The state marker was removed to invoke the worker’s exit-1 behavior. The journal records status=1/FAILURE, a scheduled restart, restart counter 1, and recovery as a new active inventory-worker process.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and post-restart recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-reboot boot ID and healthy service state were captured; the safe reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed from 151be410-d69a-4b38-8176-ab1916aae036 to d6aa02f1-7328-435c-a75d-f76fa01b867a; afterward the service was enabled, active/running, executing as inventory-worker, and its state marker remained present.

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd inventory-worker >/dev/null; then
  useradd --system --home-dir /nonexistent --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventory-worker
fi
getent passwd inventory-worker
id inventory-worker

set -eu
unit_tmp=$(mktemp)
printf '%s\n' \
  '[Unit]' \
  'Description=Inventory worker with automatic failure recovery' \
  'After=network.target' \
  '' \
  '[Service]' \
  'Type=simple' \
  'User=inventory-worker' \
  'Group=inventory-worker' \
  'ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-flaky-worker' \
  'Restart=on-failure' \
  'RestartSec=1s' \
  '' \
  '[Install]' \
  'WantedBy=multi-user.target' > "$unit_tmp"
install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$unit_tmp" /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
rm -f "$unit_tmp"
systemctl daemon-reload
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
systemctl cat inventory-worker.service
